snippet.title: The Dream of A Cockspur | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699710/_The_Dream_Of_A_Cockspur/

As one of the last remaining researchers on Earth, you and a team of investigators are sent to examine a mysterious extraterrestial object that crash-landed on a remote island...but things start to get strange as you sense an unseen horror lurking in the shadows, drawing ever closer. 

Survival horror adventure game, The Dream Of A Cockspur is coming to Steam in 2026! 
Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for release!

▼Official PLAYISM Site
https://playism.com/game/the-dream-of-a-cockspur/
